answer: Each agent attests a unique model fingerprint at registration, and the node keeps it in a vault it never exposes. A panel drawn to audit that fingerprint is voided when two members run the same model family, so the check cannot be self-graded. Quorum must then span subnetworks with no shared operator. Budget for an attacker: one distinct model deployment per identity, plus hosting, plus a panel he cannot stack. He can wander providers, but the mirror of his own weights follows him.
